_: The families, in the order they should be drawn, one sentence each.
That is ALL this file holds. It does not list the workspaces. A workspace
is a second-level directory that holds tutorboard.json, AI_INSTRUCTIONS.md
or live/ -- discovered, never registered -- because a file that has to be
edited when a directory is made is the registry this system refuses to
have. Making a new course is `mkdir courses/Topology`, and the front door
draws it on the next poll.
Two flags, and both mean 'not a workspace you can be taught in':
vendor  somebody else's repositories, tracked by pointer. Discovery
skips the family entirely -- nothing in it is the person's to
tool    the family directory IS the thing, with no workspaces under it.
`board/` is the tutoring board's own source. It is drawn on the
atlas because it is real work, and it is not offered as a
subject because it is what does the offering.
